gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO FOR AFTER EFFECTS - WETIN NYU
Vashɔn 9.2.9  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

33 nyu ANIME TIM DƐN dɔn jɔyn di Demon Slayer wan dɛn, di tim dɛn maus ɛfɛkt nau
de sho fɔ tru insay After Effects, ɛn di Tim Selɛkta na wan klin dropdown nau.

BIFO YU START
- Instɔl am pantap yu kɔrɛnt vashɔn wit yu yuzhual ZXP instɔla, dɔn ristat
  After Effects wan tɛm.
- Yu setin dɛn, tim, preset dɛn ɛn di expression dɛn we yu sev go stil de.

NYU: 33 ANIME TIM DƐN
- Flex Setin dɛn > TIM SELƐKTA > PANEL TIM nau gɛt wan grup fɔ ɛvri anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ɛn Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Ɛvri kɔrɛkta gɛt in yon luk: wetin de fala yu maus, di atak wɛn
  yu klik wan batɔn, wetin de apin wɛn yu ol di lɛft batɔn, ɛn di
  blast afta yu ol am lɛk 2.5 sɛkɔn.
- Dɛn nɔ ebi jɔs lɛk di Demon Slayer tim dɛn: di ɛfɛkt dɛn de wok onli wɛn yu de
  muv ɔ klik. Ɔf AMBIENT EFFECT DƐN fɔ kip onli di kɔlɔ dɛn.

CHENJ: TIM SELƐKTA
- Di Demon Slayer kad dɛn ɔnda PANEL TIM nɔ de igen, so Flex Setin dɛn
  dɔn shɔt. Pik ɛni tim frɔm di PANEL TIM dropdown; i de opin pan di
  tim we yu de yuz.
- Kurama ɛn Baryon nau de na di Naruto grup.

DƐN DƆN FIKS
- Di tim dɛn maus ɛfɛkt (wata, faya, layning ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn) bin kin nɔ
  sho insay After Effects, ivin wɛn Optimised Mode ɔf. Wɛn di panel sɛf bizi,
  ɔ wɛn i bizi fɔ start, i bin de luk lɛk se di tim de lag, so di
  ɛfɛkt dɛn bin de ɔf dɛnsɛf. Nau, wɛn yu graphics kad de drɔ dɛn (bɔku kɔmpyuta),
  dɛn tɛm de jɔs mek di ɛfɛkt dɛn layt smɔl fɔ shɔt tɛm.

NƆ CHENJ
- Laysɛns, aktiveshɔn ɛn ɛvri link de wok jɔs lɛk bifo.
- Di 11 Demon Slayer tim dɛn de luk jɔs lɛk na 9.2.8.
- Ɛvri ɔda tab ɛn tul de wok jɔs lɛk na 9.2.8.
================================================================================

  sho atɔl. Nau dɛn de sho ɔltɛm.
- Di PANEL TIM dropdown bin kin kip fɔ sho di ol tim in nem afta di
  tim dɔn chenj. Nau i de sho ɔltɛm di tim we de ɔn.

NƆ CHENJ
- Laysɛns, aktiveshɔn ɛn ɛvri link de wok jɔs lɛk bifo.
